Business Rules & Validations:
- Book detail: id required, 404 if not found
- Create/Edit (admin): title, author, category required; price >=0; number_in_stock >=0; prevent duplicate title+author
- Pagination: page>=1, invalid -> fallback
- Image upload: validate file type/size; prevent path traversal
Endpoints / Templates: GET /products -> products.html; GET /detail-product?id -> productdetail.html; GET /bookImage?id; Admin: /manage-product, /edit-product, /save-product, /delete-product
Data Contract (fields): Book: id(int), title(String, required), author(Author), category(Category), price(int), number_in_stock(int), image(String|null), description(String)
Security / Role Checks: Admin required for create/edit/delete; public read
Edge Cases / Negative Tests:
- price or stock negative
- missing image file
- invalid page/sortBy
- duplicate book create
- upload filename with ../

Business Rules & Validations: - Add-to-cart: book exists; quantity>0; quantity <= number_in_stock; cumulative quantity check\n- Confirm/purchase: cart non-empty; server-side recompute totals from current book.price; recheck stock before save; order.total_cost == sum(details)\n- On save: stock decremented at correct point; cart cleared after order
Endpoints / Templates: POST /add-to-cart; GET /view-cart -> user/cart; POST /purchase; POST /confirm; GET /orders; GET /delete-order-user
Data Contract (fields): Order: id,int; user(User); customer_name,String; phone,String; address,String; total_cost(int); status(String); createdAt\nOrderDetail: id,int; book(Book); number(int); total_cost(int)
Security / Role Checks: Authenticated users required for purchase; users see own orders; admin separate
Edge Cases / Negative Tests:
- quantity 0/negative
- client-tampered prices/quantities
- concurrent confirms causing negative stock
- confirm with empty cart

Business Rules & Validations: - Signup: username unique; password & confirm match; email format; password encoded; create User mapped to Account transactionally\n- Login/profile: profile require auth; proper redirect on not-auth\n- Change password: validate old password; confirm new
Endpoints / Templates: GET/POST /signup -> signup.html; GET /login -> login.html; GET /profile -> user/admin profile; POST /change-password
Data Contract (fields): Account: id,int; username,String; password(encoded), email,String, role\nUser: id (maps to account.id), name,String, phone,String, address
Security / Role Checks: Profile/change-password only for authenticated owner; admin role special views
Edge Cases / Negative Tests: - existing username\n- account created but user save fails (transaction)\n- decryptedPassword stored (security risk)

Business Rules & Validations: - Create/Edit author/category: name required; prevent duplicates\n- Edit Order: status transitions validated; order edits should preserve stock correctness\n- Delete: handle FK constraints (books linked to author/category)
Data Contract (fields): Author: id,int; name required\nCategory: id,int; name required\nAdmin: id,int; account ref
Edge Cases / Negative Tests: - delete with FK constraints\n- duplicate names on create/edit\n- invalid order status transitions

Business Rules & Validations: - Only allow comment if user has Completed order containing that book\n- star rating bounds (1..5) and content sanitized/escaped
Endpoints / Templates: POST /save-comment; productdetail.html (comment form depends on canReview)
Data Contract (fields): Comment: id,int; user(User); book(Book); star(int 1..5); content(String); createdAt
Security / Role Checks: Authenticated users only; server must verify purchase before allowing comment
Edge Cases / Negative Tests: - star out-of-range\n- content containing HTML/JS (XSS)\n- user forging username param

Business Rules & Validations: - Serve files only from uploads directory; prevent path traversal; return 404 for missing file; content-type set by extension
Endpoints / Templates: GET /uploads/{filename} (ImageController); GET /bookImage?id -> may redirect to image URL
Security / Role Checks: Public by design (images), but ensure no open-redirect or path traversal
Edge Cases / Negative Tests: - request non-existent file should be 404 (not 500)\n- malicious filename with ..\n- non-image file served with image extension

Business Rules & Validations: - Utils.getCartInSession handles null cart; services must recompute totals server-side; service-level validations for business rules (BookService, OrderService, CommentService)
Security / Role Checks: Ensure service methods enforce rules independent of controllers
Edge Cases / Negative Tests: - inconsistent cart badge counts\n- orphaned account/user on partial failures
